request: Use the highest worksheet number ever recorded in the current level instead of the latest Receive Date for Main/Zun progress.
behavior: MAX(actual_worksheet_no) over all CPWS records in the selected current level, independent of dates and history paging.
Keep existing +9 packet endpoint and 200/100 Main/Zun caps; repeated or reviewed lower packets cannot reduce progress.
Existing latest-WS/default/Incomplete calculations still use Receive Date then row ID. History remains ID descending.
CPWS/KC and AT-completion eligibility rules are unchanged; grade comparison uses the returned aggregate percentage.
Deleting or correcting the highest WS number recomputes the remaining maximum. No sticky achievement or schema is introduced.
Frontend history fallback uses the maximum available in its supplied history; the server remains authoritative over the complete history.
Removed the now-unused frontend Receive Date comparator and its implementation-only test; actual date behavior remains covered by the database suite.

before.reason: Old UI showed 130 for the latest packet although a prior packet reached 160.

notes: The first extended database fixture selected an EFL Zun that does not exist in the master data. It was corrected to a valid Math D/ZI pair; the full disposable database suite then passed.
All database test calls verify and use a private disposable PostgreSQL cluster; production pool use is poisoned until that identity is verified.
UI checks use synthetic APIs and separate browser/Electron profiles. The live application was not restarted.
